Keycloak._comment: Authority is the realm issuer. Swap this one value to move between the local Docker Keycloak and an Azure deployment - nothing else in the API changes.
Keycloak._comment2: RequireHttpsMetadata is false only because Authority is loopback (the local Docker lab). The API refuses to start if this is false for a non-loopback authority.

Sharing._comment: Mode is required and has no default: OpenFga (make api sets it, with StoreId, ModelId, OpenFgaApiKey and DirectoryClientSecret) or TenantOnly (no OpenFGA; Azure).
